name: @w6w-apps/alegra
description: Manage Alegra accounting data — invoices, contacts, items, payments, quotes and supplier bills — through Alegra's REST API.

w6w.longDescription:
Alegra is a cloud accounting and invoicing platform used by small and mid-sized businesses across Latin America and Spain. This app covers the core bookkeeping loop: list, read, create, void, delete and email sales invoices; manage contacts (clients and providers) and the product and service catalogue; register and void payments; and read quotes, supplier bills, taxes and the company profile.

Authentication is the account email plus the API token generated under Configuración > API in Alegra. Alegra identifiers are strings, lists return at most 30 records per call, and country-specific invoice fields (electronic-invoicing stamps, fiscal codes) can be supplied through each create action's additional-fields object.

Health checks track the API Alegra Contabilidad component on Alegra's status page, API reachability, and the documented 150-requests-per-minute rate-limit headroom.
